title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go; parity fixes and v1.173.0 version bumps
author: Emily Chen
description:
Motivation: SDK users have been reporting subtle differences in auth refresh, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. These differences cause production parity issues (token refresh races, inconsistent backoff, and different streaming event shapes). This PR unifies behavior across all 3 official SDKs, adds missing tests, updates docs/changelogs, and bumps package versions to v1.173.0.

What this PR does: 1) Unifies auth token refresh logic so that refresh only occurs once per client and concurrent calls wait for a single refresh promise/future. 2) Standardizes retry policy across SDKs: exponential backoff with jitter, configurable max_attempts, idempotency-aware defaults. 3) Improves streaming ergonomics: consistent event envelope ("event.type", "event.data"), adds async iterator helpers in Python/TS and channel helpers in Go, and documents migration patterns. 4) Parity fixes: address missing timeouts, unify default headers, ensure error types are mapped consistently. 5) Version bumps and changelogs for python/typescript/go to v1.173.0.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement unified auth refresh mechanism across SDKs
- [x] Implement and align retry/backoff behavior
- [x] Add streaming helper APIs and update examples
- [x] Add integration tests exercising token refresh under concurrency and simulated transient errors
- [x] Update changelogs and migration notes
- [x] Pass CI and get approvals

Notes on migration: Consumers using custom retry hooks should audit their backoff parameters (we preserved configurable knobs). Streaming consumers will get a more consistent event shape; short migration snippet added to each SDK's README.

Related: ENG-4128 (design doc), SUP-8812 (support ticket reproducing token races).

release_notes: Unified auth token refresh across SDKs; standardized retry/backoff with idempotency-aware defaults; streaming event envelope harmonized and async iterator helpers added. SDKs bumped to v1.173.0. See docs/sdk-migration/auth-retries-streaming.md for migration steps.
notes: This was a cross-repo/monorepo SDK alignment change. We intentionally kept public surface stable where possible; breaking_change=false but clients should read migration notes for retry default differences and streaming event shape clarifications. Monitoring added to track token refresh errors in next week rollout.
